name: process-and-ports
description: Background processes and listening sockets — the process/exit channels rather than plain files. Hard: tasks must launch work that outlives the command, then prove it through the kernel's process and socket tables (ps/ss), including an idempotent 'ensure it is up' check. Assumes python3 is available and ports 8086-8088 are free.

tasks.name: background-sleep
tasks.objective: start a background process running 'sleep 600' and prove that a process whose command line matches 'sleep 600' is running

tasks.name: http-server-port
tasks.objective: create the directory /tmp/ada-bench-proc and start a background HTTP server (python3 -m http.server) on port 8086 serving that directory, then prove that port 8086 is listening

tasks.name: pidfile-live-process
tasks.objective: start a background 'sleep 700' process, write its PID to /tmp/ada-bench-proc/daemon.pid, and prove that the pid file is non-empty and a process matching 'sleep 700' is running

tasks.name: ensure-port-listening
tasks.objective: ensure a background HTTP server is listening on port 8087: if nothing is listening there, start one with python3 -m http.server serving /tmp/ada-bench-proc, then prove that port 8087 is listening

tasks.name: provision-service
tasks.objective: provision a tiny service workspace at /tmp/ada-bench-proc/svc: create the directory, start a background python3 -m http.server on port 8088 serving it, record the server's PID into svc/server.pid, and prove the directory exists, port 8088 is listening, and the pid file is non-empty
